acceptance: Switching highlights the target immediately and stale responses cannot replace a newer selection.
The selected session GET starts without waiting for IndexedDB draft recovery; draft content and attachments remain recoverable.
Already-checked sessions do not trigger a redundant disk write or unconditional sidebar reload.
A newly checked session clears its local unread highlight and dot after the write succeeds.
scope: internal/server/web/app.js: session selection request order and read receipt

requirements.summary: User reports that switching between existing conversations feels slow. Preserve in-progress drafts and existing API behavior while shortening the navigation path.
evidence: Baseline b82120e599bfaefa56bf01b132822d8510c180ae; clean working tree at intake

design.summary: The UI awaited draft recovery before issuing the session GET and refreshed the complete list after each check PATCH. Start independent reads together; skip the write for sessions already checked and let the existing sessions-changed event handle list synchronization.

implementation.summary: Parallelized the independent detail and draft reads. Checked status now controls the read receipt; the receipt clears the local unread highlight and dot without a second unconditional list request.

verification.summary: Focused synthetic click regression and repository quick gate pass. New code has not yet been loaded into the running Aide instance; live desktop switch latency has not been measured. A read-only attempt to click a session in the current desktop UI was interrupted when that UI state changed during the operation, so it is not acceptance evidence.
